description: This file defines a class 'TextFileReader' that supports reading and processing text files, including methods for reading lines, processing individual files, processing directories, and counting files with only deleted lines. It includes logging and file handling logic.

classes.name: TextFileReader
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to read and process text files, including handling of file reading, directory traversal, and counting specific file types.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a TextFileReader instance with a filesystem and processor, and sets counters.

methods.name: _read_lines
methods.description: Reads a file at a given path and returns its lines as a list.

methods.name: process_file
methods.description: Processes a specified file by reading its contents and passing lines to the processor, with error handling.

methods.name: _process_directory
methods.description: Recursively processes all files in a directory.

methods.name: process_paths
methods.description: Processes a list of paths, handling directories and files.

methods.name: count_delete_only_file
methods.description: Increments a counter for files containing only deleted lines.
